latest_release.name: v8.8.3 - Docker Alpine PHP2SHELL security patch
latest_release.body:
> [!CAUTION] > **This version of Snipe-IT REQUIRES PHP 8.2.0 or greater, 8.4+ recommended.** PHP 8.2 is still in security release support until 31 Dec 2026, but let's not play that game - and some of the new features we're working on will require PHP 8.3+, so... get on that, ferreal! Didja miss us? Sorry for the extra tagging/release noise, but we were notified that we released 8.8.2 about 10 minutes before Alpine released their patched PHP versions, so we had to rebuild and push the updated tags.
Cringey millennial meme
Ubuntu docker users were already covered by the previous release, so this is just for the docker Alpine folks. It's... been a long day on our side, probably pretty long on your side too.
Cringey millennial meme
Stay safe out there, folks. ## What's Changed * Fixed #19895 - remove PHP 8.4/8.5 deprecation notices by @sudarshanvashisht in https://github.com/grokability/snipe-it/pull/19896 ## New Contributors * @sudarshanvashisht made their first contribution in https://github.com/grokability/snipe-it/pull/19896 **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/grokability/snipe-it/compare/v8.8.2...v8.8.3
